correctness.rationale: Eight equilateral octahedral facets each have Euclidean area sqrt(3)/2. The central section normal to any facet is a regular hexagon with Euclidean area 3sqrt(3)/4 and Minkowski self-area 3 (six unit gauge edges). Thus each facet contributes (sqrt(3)/2)*3/(3sqrt(3)/4)=2 and total self-perimeter=16, omega3=16/3. Wolansky Theorem 4.2 gives product multiplicativity, and omega2(H)=3 for affine regular hexagon: product omega_(2k+1)=16/3*3^(k-1)=(8/9)(2*3^k). The computations respect recursive rather than Euclidean volume, and exact geometry plus induction establish the all-k statement.
